operations.description: Measure a rendered part for debugging: envelope, volume, watertightness, body count, cross-sections on the planes you ask for, and whether probe points are solid or empty. Use it to find why a cad_check assertion fails. Diagnostic only: it does not bind request assertions or establish verification.
operations.summary: Measure a part for debugging (sections, probe points); not verification.

params.description: Re-render with these overrides before measuring (nothing is committed).

axis.description: Axis normal to the cutting plane (axis-aligned cut).

at.description: Plane coordinate along that axis, in mm. Cut through the middle of the feature you want to see, not exactly on a face.

origin.description: Point on an oblique cutting plane [x,y,z] mm. Use with `normal` for inclined holes.

normal.description: Normal of an oblique cutting plane. Use with `origin` when the cut is not axis-aligned.

sections.description: Extra cutting planes to report, beyond the automatic mid-planes.

probes.description: Points (x,y,z) in mm to classify as solid or empty.

timeoutMs.description: Render timeout if the part must be rendered again (default 90000).

detail.description: Result size: brief (outcome, failures, next step) or full (default).

operations.name: cad.check
operations.description: Verify a part against expectations taken from the request, never copied from the measured report: overall size, bodies, holes by position and diameter and, for more detail, envelope corners, volume, solid and empty points, cross-section outlines and preservation of unrelated geometry. Call it with autoCommit true: the complete check runs as a trial and is committed as the verification only when everything passes. A failing run binds nothing, so fix the part or the mistaken assertion and call again. Returns each assertion result, ready, verificationStatus, the normalized expectation and the next action. Only ready true is verified; do not claim completion on failed, scope_changed, partial or unverified. Example: {"artifactId":"<part id>","autoCommit":true,"expect":{"size":[40,30,5],"bodies":1,"holes":[{"at":[10,10,2.5],"d":4}]}}
operations.summary: Verify a part against request dimensions; autoCommit binds only a passing check.

at.description: Point on the hole axis, inside the material.

expect.description: From the request, never copied from the report.

params.description: Check a parameter variant instead of the recorded values (nothing is committed).

size.description: Overall size [x, y, z] in mm, wherever the part sits.

at.description: Point on the hole axis inside the material, e.g. at mid-thickness.

holes.description: Round holes by a point on the axis and a diameter (short form of sections).

tol.description: Linear tolerance in mm where an assertion gives none (default 0.1).

bbox.description: Overall envelope: exact min and max corner in mm (default tolerance 0.1 mm).

volume.description: Expected solid volume in mm³ (default tolerance 1.5 %, which absorbs polygonal circle approximation).

solid.description: Points (x,y,z) that must lie inside material.

empty.description: Points (x,y,z) that must lie in empty space (e.g. hole centers, pockets, outside chamfers).

axis.description: Axis normal to the cutting plane.

at.description: Coordinate of the cutting plane along that axis (pick a plane through the middle of the feature, not on a face).

center.description: Hole center in the two in-plane axes (x,y for a z-section; x,z for a y-section; y,z for an x-section).

holes.description: Circular holes that must appear in this plane.

holeCount.description: Exact number of cut-out loops in this plane (catches missing or extra cuts).

outerCount.description: Exact number of separate material regions in this plane.

center.description: [a, b] in the two in-plane axes, in mm

size.description: [a, b] in the two in-plane axes, in mm

slots.description: Non-circular cut-outs (slots, pockets, windows) by bounding-box size and center.

center.description: [a, b] in the two in-plane axes, in mm

polygons.description: Regular-polygon cut-outs (e.g. hex nut traps) by side count and across-flats width; orientation-independent.

size.description: Rectangular outline size in the two in-plane axes.

center.description: [a, b] in the two in-plane axes, in mm

outer.description: Shape of the largest material region in this plane.

materialArea.description: Net material area in the plane (mm²).

sections.description: Cross-section assertions — the primary way to verify holes, bores, slots and wall outlines.

watertight.description: Require a closed manifold mesh (default true).

shells.description: Expected number of disconnected bodies (1 for a single part).

minRoundness.description: Minimum roundness for circular features, apothem/radius (default 0.97 ≈ $fn ≥ 13).

maxSelfIntersections.description: Fail if more than this many triangle pairs interpenetrate (0 = no self-intersection). Detects overlapping bodies that still look like a valid bbox/volume.

center.description: Center of a sphere (mm) that is allowed to change.

changeRegions.description: Regions where the edit is allowed; everything else must match the approved baseline (or initial draft ancestor).

preserve.description: Require unrelated geometry to match the approved baseline (or initial draft ancestor) (sampled points outside changeRegions).

expect.description: What must be true of the part, taken from the request: size, bodies and holes, or envelope, volume, points and cross-sections for more detail.

autoCommit.description: true: trial the complete check and commit it in the same call only when everything passes and no committed assertion is dropped or changed. A failing run binds nothing.

exploratory.description: true: trial only, never binds. Omitted or false without autoCommit: commit the expectations even if they fail; they then stay binding.

timeoutMs.description: Render timeout if the part must be rendered again (default 90000).

detail.description: Result size: brief (outcome, failures, next step) or full (default).

detail.description: Result size: brief (outcome, failures, next step) or full (default).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: cad.compose
operations.description: Place existing parts together with translate and rotate to make one combined part (no mates, no STEP). Each part's source is wrapped in its own module so variable names do not collide. Returns a new mechanical artifact with the combined mesh and its measured report.
operations.summary: Place existing parts together by translate and rotate as one new part.

revisionId.description: Pin the part revision placed in this snapshot.

instances.description: Parts to place. Each source is wrapped in its own module so file-scope names do not collide.

rationale.description: One line on why these parts are placed together.

detail.description: Result size: brief (outcome, failures, next step) or full (default).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: cad.export
operations.description: Export a part to a file. format "step" writes a STEP solid matching the checked render: "brep" (exact surfaces) is rebuilt from the source and compared with it, else "faceted" (planar faces). stl and scad copy the stored file. Use it only when asked for a file. Returns the path, method and checks.
operations.summary: Export a part as STEP, STL or SCAD; only when the person asked.

revisionId.description: Defaults to the baseline; for an agent, the newest revision.

format.description: step: a solid matching the checked render; stl, scad: the stored file.

destPath.description: File to write; an agent writes under exports/, e.g. "exports/bracket.step".

method.description: STEP only: auto (default) is exact when possible, else faceted; faceted always.

timeoutMs.description: Limit for the whole export, ms (default 120000).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: calculation.run
operations.description: Run a unit-aware calculation and save it as a calculation artifact. Give templateId or expression, and named inputs with units. Returns the result with its unit, the revision and its limitations; unchanged is true when a re-run reproduced the recorded result. By default it is submitted for review.
operations.summary: Run a unit-aware calculation from a template or expression and save it.

artifactId.description: Existing calculation to re-run as a new revision. Omit to create one.

templateId.description: Template id from calculation_templates. Give this or expression.

expression.description: Formula over the input names, e.g. "mass * g". Give this or templateId.

inputs.description: Input values, each {name, quantity: {value, unit}}: name is the variable used in the expression. Add sourceRef {artifactId, revisionId} when the value came from an artifact.

outputUnit.description: Unit to report the result in, e.g. "Wh". Omit it and the unit follows from the expression; a result that could be energy or torque needs it.

title.description: Title for a new calculation artifact.

submitForReview.description: Also submit the result as a proposal. Pass false to keep it a draft.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: calculation.explain_inputs
operations.description: List the inputs of a saved calculation with where each value came from and whether its source has moved on since. Use it to see why a calculation is stale or to audit its inputs. Returns the inputs, expression and freshness. Experimental.
operations.summary: Explain a calculation's inputs and where each value came from.

operations.name: calculation.templates
operations.description: List the calculation templates: id, title, expression, the inputs each needs with units, output unit, assumptions and limitations. Call it before calculation_run to pick a templateId and its input names. Experimental: a result is not verified evidence.
operations.summary: List calculation templates with their inputs and units.

operations.name: wiring.validate
operations.description: Run the wiring checks on a wiring artifact: voltage ranges, ground return, shared signal pins, changed components and pins it knows nothing about. Returns the revision checked, findings with severity and what the checks cover. It is not a full electrical rule check and does not prove safety.
operations.summary: Run wiring checks (voltage, ground, pin conflicts) and list findings.

revisionId.description: Revision to use. Defaults to the newest draft, else the approved one.

operations.name: wiring.render
operations.description: Build the connection table and an SVG diagram for a wiring artifact. Use it to review what was recorded. A diagram is not validation: call wiring_validate for the checks. Returns the table and the diagram.
operations.summary: Render a wiring artifact as a connection table and SVG diagram.

revisionId.description: Revision to use. Defaults to the newest draft, else the approved one.

operations.name: wiring.set_pins
operations.description: Set the pin list of a wiring artifact. The list you send replaces every existing pin, so include them all. Create the wiring artifact first with artifact_create_draft (type "wiring") and the components before that. Saves a new draft revision and returns it.
operations.summary: Replace the pin list of a wiring artifact (send every pin).

pin.description: Pin label as printed on the part or its datasheet, e.g. "GND".

type.description: Electrical role. The ground-return check needs power and ground pins typed.

voltageRange.description: Allowed voltage as two quantities, e.g. min {"value": 4.5, "unit": "V"}.

pins.description: Every pin of the wiring; replaces the previous list.

baseRevisionId.description: Revision to build on. Defaults to the newest draft, else the approved one.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: wiring.set_connections
operations.description: Set the connections of a wiring artifact. The list you send replaces every existing connection, so include them all. Each has a from and to end (component and pin) and a signal role; ids are assigned for you. Saves a new draft revision and returns it; then call wiring_validate.
operations.summary: Replace the connections of a wiring artifact (send every connection).

id.description: Leave it out: one is assigned. Send an id only to keep an existing connection.

from.description: End it starts at: componentArtifactId and the pin label. componentRevisionId is optional and defaults to the approved revision of the component, else its newest.

to.description: End it goes to, same shape as from.

wire.description: Wire gauge, e.g. "22 AWG", and its current rating as a quantity.

connections.description: Every connection of the wiring; replaces the previous list.

baseRevisionId.description: Revision to build on. Defaults to the newest draft, else the approved one.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: proposal.submit
operations.description: Ask the human to review draft revisions. Use it only when the person asked for review or approval; a proposal cannot be changed once submitted and you can never approve it yourself. Each change names an artifact and the draft revision to approve: kind is "new_artifact" when the artifact has no approved revision yet, otherwise "baseline_update" with baseRevisionId set to the currently approved revision. Returns the pending proposal with its downstream impact. Example: {"changes":[{"artifactId":"<artifact id>","newRevisionId":"<draft revision id>","kind":"new_artifact"}],"reason":"First draft of the payload requirement"}
operations.summary: Ask the human to review draft revisions; only when review was requested.

example.reason: First draft of the payload requirement

kind.description: new_artifact when nothing is approved yet.

baseRevisionId.description: Currently approved revision of the artifact. Omit or null when it has none.

newRevisionId.description: Draft revision the human is asked to approve.

kind.description: new_artifact when the artifact has no approved revision yet, baseline_update when it has. The other kinds are made by component_propose_selection and bom_propose_edit.

changes.description: Draft revisions to review, one entry per artifact.

reason.description: What is proposed and why, in a sentence the reviewer can check.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: proposal.read
operations.description: Read one proposal: its state, reason, impact and, for each change, the artifact with its approved revision and the proposed one. Use it to see what the reviewer was asked or what they answered. Returns the proposal and its changes.
operations.summary: Read a proposal: state, changes, impact and the reviewer's answer.

operations.name: proposal.wait
operations.description: Wait until the human resolves a proposal or the timeout passes, whichever comes first. Returns the proposal state; "pending" means the wait timed out and nothing was decided. Use it only after proposal_submit, when you were asked to continue after review.
operations.summary: Wait for the human to resolve a proposal, up to a timeout.

timeoutMs.description: Longest time to wait, in milliseconds.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous proposal_wait result.

operations.name: proposal.list
operations.description: List proposals, newest first, optionally only those in one state. Use it to find pending reviews or the ones the reviewer sent back with changes requested. Returns each proposal with its changes, reason and state.
operations.summary: List proposals, optionally filtered by state.

operations.name: proposal.approve
operations.description: Approve a proposal (human only)
operations.summary: Approve a proposal (human only)

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: proposal.reject
operations.description: Reject a proposal (human only)
operations.summary: Reject a proposal (human only)

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: proposal.request_changes
operations.description: Request changes on a proposal
operations.summary: Request changes on a proposal

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: work.status
operations.description: Check what is still unfinished before you say the work is done. Returns ready, a one-line summary, and each outstanding item (unverified or failing parts, components without a source or offer, unvalidated wiring, calculations not run, changes the reviewer requested, empty drafts) with the exact tool call that resolves it, plus the proposals waiting on the human. Call it before your final answer and again after fixing items. Finish only when ready is true, or name every remaining blocker.
operations.summary: Call before your final answer: lists unfinished work and the next call for each.

scope.description: session (default): your work. project: everything unfinished.
session: work from this agent session (the default for agents). project: everything unfinished in the project.

operations.name: guide.read
operations.description: Read a short numbered playbook for one kind of work. Topics: start, requirements, parts, cad, cad-verify, wiring, calculation, tests, review, finish. Read a topic once before your first task of that kind; with no topic it returns the start guide. Returns the text and the list of all topics with when to use each.
operations.summary: Read a short step-by-step playbook for one kind of work.

topic.description: One of: start, requirements, parts, cad, cad-verify, wiring, calculation, tests, review, finish. Omit for start.

operations.description: Read job status/log
operations.summary: Read job status/log

operations.description: Cancel an owned job

operations.description: List agent/tool availability
operations.summary: List agent/tool availability

operations.name: tool.doctor
operations.description: Check that the engineering tools are installed and working: OpenSCAD, and the optional Python with OCP for exact STEP. Use it when a CAD call fails because a tool is missing. Returns one result per tool.
operations.summary: Check that OpenSCAD and the optional STEP converter work.

toolId.description: Tool to check: "openscad" or "python". Omit for all.

operations.name: tool.describe
operations.description: Look up tools. With no arguments it returns the catalogue: every tool with its pack and a one-line summary. With tool it returns the full input schema of that tool and an example call. Add artifactType to also get the payload fields of that artifact type, which you need before artifact_create_draft or artifact_update_draft. Example: {"tool":"artifact_create_draft","artifactType":"requirement"}
operations.summary: List every tool, or with tool get its schema, an example and payload fields.

tool.description: Tool name, e.g. "cad_check". Omit to list every tool.

op.description: Same as tool. Give one of the two, not both.

artifactType.description: Include the payload schema for this artifact type when authoring or updating artifacts.

operations.name: tool.call
operations.description: Call any Omen Flow tool by name, including the ones not listed for this session. Take the name from the tool_describe catalogue and its arguments from tool_describe with that tool, then pass them as input. Returns exactly what the named tool returns, including its errors. Tools reserved for the human, such as approving a proposal, are refused. Example: {"tool":"wiring_validate","input":{"artifactId":"<wiring artifact id>"}}
operations.summary: Call any tool by name with its arguments, including tools not listed here.

tool.description: Tool name from the tool_describe catalogue.
Name of the tool to call, e.g. "wiring_validate".

input.description: That tool's arguments, as an object. Omit when it takes none.

operations.name: test.create_draft
operations.description: Create a test artifact: a numbered procedure with expected outcomes and conditions, linked to the requirements it validates. It records the plan only. Returns the test artifact and its draft revision; record observations later with test_record_result.
operations.summary: Create a test procedure draft linked to the requirements it validates.

procedure.instruction: Load 0.3 kg on the tray and drive 5 m

title.description: Name of the test, e.g. "Payload lift test".

procedure.description: Ordered steps, each {step, instruction, expected}; step numbers start at 1.

requirementRefs.description: Requirements this test validates, each as {artifactId}. revisionId is optional and defaults to the approved revision of the requirement, else its newest.

conditions.description: Setup and conditions the test is run under.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: test.record_result
operations.description: Record one observation on a test artifact: what was observed, the outcome and the kind of evidence. Record only what was actually observed or measured, and never invent a run. Your result is saved as a draft revision for the human to review; earlier results are kept.
operations.summary: Record an actual observation and outcome on a test artifact.

example.observation: Carried 0.3 kg for 5 m in 12 s without tipping

artifactId.description: Test artifact the result belongs to.

expectedRevisionId.description: Revision this observation was entered against. Refuse if the revision the result would extend has changed, so the observation can be reviewed before retrying.

requirementRef.description: Requirement the result speaks to, as {artifactId}. It must be one the test validates; revisionId defaults to the revision the test was written for.

evidenceKind.description: How the result was obtained. measured only for a real physical measurement.

observation.description: What was actually observed, with values and units.

result.description: Outcome. Use not_run or planned when nothing was observed.

attachments.description: Evidence files such as logs or photos, each {path, contentBase64 or sourcePath}: path is project-relative, sourcePath an existing project file to copy.

measurementOrigin.description: File, instrument or person the measurement came from.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.

operations.name: build.preview
operations.description: Preview the build package: every artifact with the revision that would be exported and the issues that hold it back (no approved revision, stale inputs, unverified CAD, unresolved assumption, pending proposal). Read-only. Returns the items and counts.
operations.summary: Preview the build package and the issues that hold it back.

operations.name: build.export
operations.description: Export the build package as a ZIP file. Use it only when the person asked for an export. It fails while issues remain unless includeDrafts is true, and the package is then labelled DRAFT. Returns the path, file count and status.
operations.summary: Export the build package as a ZIP; only when asked.

destPath.description: Path of the ZIP file to write.

includeDrafts.description: Export although issues remain; the package is then labelled DRAFT.

label.description: Label recorded in the package manifest.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; reuse the same key only when retrying the identical call.
